meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: I'll be there in ten minutes.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: куда ты спешишь? = where are you rushing to?

examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?
We are in a big hurry for the train.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

принять.gloss: to receive, to see (a visitor); to accept

meanings.en: shower (bathroom apparatus or act of washing)

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

надоесть.gloss: to bore, to get on someone's nerves

meanings.note: the person who is fed up is in the dative: 'мне надоело' = I'm fed up
вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

examples.trans: The mayor isn't seeing anyone today.
The doctor sees patients in the morning.

meanings.en: far, far away, a long way

examples.trans: The shop is far from the house.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

examples.text: Я устал, потому что много работал.
examples.trans: I'm tired because I worked a lot.

meanings.en: to lie, to be lying down, to rest

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
The book is lying on the table.
There's someone here to see you.

переехать.gloss: to move (to a new home or city)

examples.trans: They moved into a new flat.
